objective: Teach new support agents to classify shipping eligibility using only the supplied rules.
rule_summary: Eligibility implies paid=true and item_count>=1; these are necessary, not stated as sufficient.
If either input is missing, eligibility is undetermined.
If paid=false or item_count<1, the necessary-condition rule determines ineligibility.
overlap_diagnosis: E1 and E2 share the same signature: paid=true and item_count>=1. Both remain undetermined because satisfying necessary conditions does not establish eligibility; retain E1 and consolidate E2.

examples.rule_applied: The order satisfies both necessary conditions, but no sufficiency rule is supplied.
examples.meaningful_difference: Retains one supplied normal-looking case without treating necessary conditions as sufficient.

examples.scenario: An order has paid=false and item_count=2.
examples.rule_applied: Eligibility is allowed only when paid=true; that necessary condition fails.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether the order is eligible.
examples.meaningful_difference: Changes only paid from true to false.

examples.scenario: An order has paid=true and item_count=0.
examples.rule_applied: Eligibility requires item_count>=1; zero fails that condition.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether the order is eligible.

examples.scenario: An order has unknown payment status and item_count=2.
examples.rule_applied: A missing input makes eligibility undetermined.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether eligibility can be determined.
examples.meaningful_difference: Removes only payment status from the baseline.

examples.scenario: An order has paid=true and no item_count value.
examples.rule_applied: A missing input makes eligibility undetermined.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether eligibility can be determined.
examples.meaningful_difference: Removes only item_count from the baseline.

preservation_note: E1 preserves the supplied baseline; E2 is consolidated as repetitive. Synthetic cases add each supported counter-decision and both requested missing-input states.

missing_information: No rule states that paid=true and item_count>=1 are sufficient for eligibility.
No conflict-handling or rule-precedence criteria were supplied.
